_readme: Terminology for the Arabic (ar_SA) translation of os-linkhealth. Every entry is the wording the owner's own Arabic already uses, harvested from his OPNsense translation (opnsense-arabic/ar_SA.po, byte-identical to the OPNsense.mo installed on the firewall at /usr/local/share/locale/ar_SA/LC_MESSAGES/, verified 2026-09-21) and from his os-netreport catalogues. Keys are English terms; each value carries 'ar' (use this), 'src' (where it comes from) and, where the choice is not obvious, 'note'. 'src: chosen' marks a term none of his catalogues contains - it is this glossary's own proposal, built to sit beside his wording, and the note says why.
_style: Formal but unhurried; no exclamation marks that are not in the English; no marketing tone.
Say 'could not' with تعذّر, as he does: 'The test message could not be sent.' -> تعذّر إرسال الرسالة التجريبية.
Passive/impersonal for things the plugin did: أُرسل، تُخزَّن، لم يُرسل - as in his os-netreport strings.
Enable = تفعيل, never تمكين (his deliberate decision, 560+ places).
Threshold = العتبة; الحد is kept for 'limit' only (his rules.py).
Plugin = المكوّن الإضافي; switch (the device) = المبدّل; entry = الإدخال (his rules.py).

Latin script and Latin digits stay as they are: numbers, ppm, dBm, mA, igb0, crc_errs, 10GBASE-SR, SFP+, RJ45, LLDP, CRC, MAC, PCI, SMBIOS, led(4), OPNsense, Monit, node_exporter, LCDproc, PortA1, Port9.
He writes acronyms unchanged inside Arabic and inflects around them: 'عنوان MAC', 'خدمة LLDP', 'أقصى TTL'. Do the same for CRC, LLDP, SFP+, MTU.
He keeps the shadda in عدّاد/عدّادات and مفعّل; keep it.
_do_not_translate: igb0, ix1, igb8 and every other interface name
crc_errs, checksum_errs and every other counter name
ppm, dBm, mA, Mbit/s, GB, °C and every other unit
10GBASE-SR, 1000BASE-SX, SFP, SFP+, RJ45, LLDP, CRC, MAC, PCI, SMBIOS, MTU, DOM, led(4)
PortA1, Port9, SFP+2 and every other chassis label
/var/tmp/node_exporter/linkhealth.prom, faceplates.json and every other path or filename
_conflicts: firewall: his OPNsense translation says جدار الحماية (135 places, including the top-level menu); his os-netreport says الجدار الناري (4 places, which are the netreport strings merged into the .po). The GUI around this plugin shows جدار الحماية - use that.

link: his catalogue says الارتباط wherever link means the Ethernet link itself (Link State, Link Type, Link Parameters, Link MTU, link speed) and الرابط/رابط where it means a PPP or logical link. This plugin only ever means the first - use الارتباط.

vendor: OPNsense 'Vendor' -> المُصنّع; os-netreport 'vendor' (a device's OUI maker) -> الشركة المصنّعة; OPNsense 'Manufacturer' -> الشركة المصنعة. For the transceiver's Vendor field use المُصنّع, which is what his GUI prints under that exact label.
packet loss: his catalogue carries both فقد الحزم and فقدان الحزم. The gateway column his GUI actually shows is فقد الحزم - use that.
driver: 'Driver' -> برنامج التشغيل everywhere except one dashboard string that says مشغّل Netclient. Use برنامج التشغيل.
total: OPNsense 'Total' -> الإجمالي; os-netreport 'total' -> المجموع. This is a GUI string, so use الإجمالي.

physical: 'Physical'/'physical' -> فعلي (the physical interface = الواجهة الفعلية), but 'the physical device' -> الجهاز المادي. Use فعلي for ports and interfaces, مادي only where the English means 'in the metal'.
Enabled: the bare string 'Enabled' is مفعل in his catalogue while every other occurrence is مفعّل (قاعدة مفعّلة، معلومات / مفعّل). The shadda is almost certainly missing by accident - write مفعّل.

physical port.note: Plural المنافذ الفعلية; matches his الواجهة الفعلية for 'physical interface'.

interface.note: Plural الواجهات. Do not use الواجهة الأمامية for anything here - he uses that for 'frontend'.

socket.note: Silent in his catalogues. المقبس is the ordinary Arabic for a physical jack, and the page needs a word distinct from المنفذ, which it already spends on 'port'.

cable.src: OPNsense ar_SA 'Select the type of cable connecting the UPS to the server.' -> نوع الكابل

transceiver.note: Silent in his catalogues. Long, but it is the transparent term and he does not shy from long exact ones (عرض النطاق الترددي، المكوّن الإضافي). SFP/SFP+ stay Latin beside it.

module (transceiver).src: OPNsense ar_SA 'Either an input or module needs to be specified.' -> وحدة
module (transceiver).note: Use الوحدة wherever the English shortens 'transceiver' to 'module' (module alarm, module flags, the module vanished).

appliance.src: OPNsense ar_SA 'your Infoblox appliance' -> جهاز Infoblox
appliance.note: Same word he uses for 'device'; context on this page always makes it the box itself.

chassis.note: Silent in his catalogues. الهيكل is the standard Arabic for a chassis and leaves الجهاز free for 'appliance'.

chassis label.note: For the field 'Name on the chassis' use الاسم على الهيكل, which is what the English says there.

printed name / printed label.note: The page turns on the difference between a name somebody typed and a name printed on the metal; المطبوع carries that and nothing more.

front panel.note: Silent in his catalogues. Do not reach for الواجهة الأمامية: he already spends that on 'frontend'.

faceplate.note: Same rendering as 'front panel'. In this plugin 'faceplate' is a bay name meaning the appliance's own fixed plate, as opposed to a pluggable module; if a sentence needs the contrast, write اللوحة الأمامية للجهاز.

bay.note: Silent in his catalogues (his only 'slot' is 'short slot time'). الحيّز reads as the space a module sits in and does not collide with المنفذ or الفتحة.

link.note: See _conflicts: الرابط is his word for a PPP or logical link, not for this one.

no link.note: Built on his الارتباط; reads as a state badge.

down (link).note: The state means the link is not active - no cable, or nothing answering. Keep it distinct from معطّل below.

disabled.note: Only for a port administratively switched off in the configuration.

speed.src: OPNsense ar_SA 'Default interface link speed' -> سرعة ارتباط الواجهة

duplex.src: OPNsense ar_SA 'Speed and duplex' -> السرعة ووضع الإرسال
duplex.note: 'duplex mismatch' -> عدم تطابق وضع الإرسال. If a sentence needs full duplex specifically, وضع الإرسال الكامل (كامل الازدواج).

downshift.note: Silent in his catalogues. The plugin means a port settling below the fastest speed it advertises; هبوط السرعة says exactly that without inventing a fault.

supported media.note: This is the natural anchor for 'the list of speeds this port advertises' and for 'What this port can do'.

advertise (a speed).src: OPNsense ar_SA 'Advertise a specific MTU to clients' -> الإعلان عن قيمة MTU

link changes / flaps.src: OPNsense ar_SA 'Log Neighbor Changes' -> تسجيل تغييرات الجيران
link changes / flaps.note: The plugin never says 'flap' to the user, only 'link changes'; keep the Arabic just as plain.

errors in.note: Exactly his wording on the interface statistics page.

counter.note: Keep the shadda, as he writes it.

corrupted (frames).note: الإطارات التالفة is the plain Arabic for frames that failed CRC; do not escalate it to مدمّرة or فاسدة.

traffic.src: OPNsense ar_SA 'blocks traffic from IP addresses' -> حظر حركة المرور
traffic.note: 'no traffic' -> بلا حركة; 'not enough traffic' -> حركة غير كافية.

ppm.note: Stays Latin, and so do the figures beside it (100 ppm، 1000 ppm، 38000).

verdict.note: Silent in his catalogues. الحكم keeps the English word's honesty: it is a judgement the plugin issues, not a measurement it read. Do not soften it to التقييم or الحالة.

judge (verb).note: 'not enough traffic to judge' -> حركة غير كافية للحكم; 'Frames needed to judge' -> الإطارات اللازمة للحكم.

clean.note: Drop his emoji: this is a table badge, not a mail report.

watch (state).note: A badge meaning 'worth watching', not 'being monitored'. Bare مراقبة would read as the latter.

watch (verb) / watched.note: 'Watch the physical ports' -> مراقبة المنافذ الفعلية; the 'Watched' column -> مُراقَب.

failing.note: The noun 'a fault', not an adjective: it names what the page found without claiming which component died. Sits beside متوقف (down) and معطّل (disabled) without being either.

fault.note: 'a physical fault' -> عطل مادي - here the English means 'in the metal', so مادي, not فعلي.

idle.note: In this plugin idle means too little traffic to judge - neither good nor bad. Never render it as سليم or as a problem.

unstable.note: For a port whose link keeps going away.

recover (return to clean).note: 'Mail when a port recovers' -> إرسال بريد عند عودة المنفذ سليمًا.

optics.note: Silent in his catalogues. بصري is the standard Arabic for optical; القياسات keeps it to what the plugin actually reads.

supply voltage.note: Silent in his catalogues; جهد is the standard Arabic for voltage.

voltage.note: Silent in his catalogues. Do not reuse الطاقة, which he spends on mains power in the dashboard widgets.

receive power.note: Built on his قدرة الإرسال. Note he uses الطاقة for mains power - that is a different word from this one.

transmit bias.note: Silent in his catalogues; the SFP figure is a bias current in mA.

alarm.note: 'module alarm' -> إنذار الوحدة; 'module warning' -> تحذير الوحدة.

window.note: The measurement window. 'This window' -> هذه النافذة; 'Window length' -> طول النافذة. Keep it distinct from الفترة, which this plugin spends on 'period'.

period.note: Used for the link-change period and for 'the period the verdict counts'.

sweep.note: Silent in his catalogues. الجولة reads as one pass of the collector over every port; المسح would suggest scanning, and الدورة is already spent on 'cycle'.

cycle.src: OPNsense ar_SA Monit poll time 'CYCLES' -> الدورات
cycle.note: 'give it one cycle' -> امنحه دورة واحدة.

baseline.note: Silent in his catalogues; خط الأساس is the standard term.

interval.note: His compound pattern is فاصل + noun: فاصل الفحص، فاصل الاستطلاع.

threshold.note: الحد stays for 'limit' - his rules.py says so explicitly.

override.src: OPNsense ar_SA 'Edit Host Override' -> تعديل تجاوز المضيف
override.note: 'Edit port override' -> تعديل تجاوز المنفذ; 'a port override on the Settings tab' -> تجاوز منفذ في تبويب الإعدادات.

settings.note: Also his word for 'configuration' (تجاوز ملف الإعدادات).

integration.note: Silent in his catalogues; the Settings tab heading over the node_exporter option.

plugin.src: OPNsense ar_SA 'Plugin details' -> تفاصيل المكوّن الإضافي

firmware.note: Singular, always - his rules.py unified it.

bridge address table.note: The English calls it the bridge address table; جدول عناوين MAC في الجسر is the clearest rendering.

switch (the device).note: Never المحوّل - that is his word for an adapter.

mail (verb).src: OPNsense ar_SA 'E-Mail Alert' -> تنبيه بالبريد الإلكتروني
mail (verb).note: 'nothing is mailed' -> لا يُرسل أي بريد, which is how he puts it in os-netreport.

cooldown.note: Silent in his catalogues. مهلة is his word for a timeout, and التهدئة carries the 'one message per port, then quiet' sense.

saturate.src: OPNsense ar_SA 'Saturation exceeded' -> تم تجاوز التشبّع
saturate.note: 'Saturate the link and test' -> أشبِع الارتباط واختبره.

flood.src: OPNsense ar_SA 'Delay reflood' -> تأخير إعادة الإغراق

identify.note: Here it means locating the socket physically, not naming it: 'Identify {port}' -> تحديد {port}, 'Identify that one too' -> حدِّد ذلك المنفذ أيضًا.

blink (verb).note: Imperative أومِض: 'Blink this socket' -> أومِض هذا المقبس. 'is blinking now' -> يومض الآن.

blinking (noun).note: 'Stop the blinking' -> أوقف الوميض; 'The blinking has finished' -> انتهى الوميض.

LED.note: Keep LED Latin inside the Arabic, the way he writes عنوان MAC and خدمة LLDP. 'identification LED' -> مؤشر LED للتعريف.

light.note: For 'the light above the socket' - the thing you look at, as opposed to the LED the driver registers.

confirm / confirmation.note: In this plugin a confirmation is a person who watched a socket blink. Keep that weight; do not write تحقق.

could not (be read, started, saved).src: os-netreport ar_SA 'The test message could not be sent.' -> تعذّر إرسال الرسالة التجريبية
could not (be read, started, saved).note: His standard opening for a failure the plugin is reporting about itself.

leave empty.src: os-netreport ar_SA 'Leave empty to use the default recipients' -> اتركه فارغًا
leave empty.note: Feminine اتركها when the noun is feminine, as he does for كلمة المرور.

at most a minute from now.note: The page says this three times; keep one wording for all three.

_honesty: These sentences are why the plugin is trusted. Translate the claim exactly, and do not hedge it into قد or ربما when the English does not.
'This arrangement has not been checked against the metal yet.' -> لم يُقابَل هذا الترتيب بالجهاز نفسه بعد. NOT قد لا يكون دقيقًا.
'A table is a claim, not a witness: nobody has looked at the metal on your behalf.' - keep both halves; ادّعاء and شاهد carry it.
'it was not read off the appliance by this plugin' -> ولم يقرأه هذا المكوّن الإضافي من الجهاز. Say who did not do what.
'This plugin will not call a mapping confirmed on the strength of a table' - the refusal is the point; keep لن.
'Nothing was sent anywhere.' -> لم يُرسل شيء إلى أي جهة. Flat and complete.
'The record lives in this firewall alone.' -> السجل موجود في جدار الحماية هذا وحده.
'that is the other way to be sure, and it is just as good a witness' - keep the equality; do not demote it to بديل.
'Packet loss on its own says nothing about a cable' -> فقد الحزم وحده لا يقول شيئًا عن الكابل. Keep وحده.
'Every number here is the change over one window.' - التغيّر، not القيمة: the whole distinction is in that word.
